en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a riverside city scene. A stone bridge crosses the water in the foreground, with small boats moored along the quay. Behind the bridge stand several ornate multi‑storey buildings, including a large corner hotel and a tall clock tower. The overall style is early 20th‑century European urban architecture. Printed caption text at the top identifies the location as Norrköping and mentions Oscar Fredriksbro and Göta hotell.
